name: Lufia
source:
An elven acolyte. She is introverted and prone to self-victimization. Though she laments her situation, she has resigned herself to it. Her homeland was swallowed by a great calamity, and both of her parents remain missing. After wandering for some time, she was picked up by humans and ultimately bought by the church.

[Translated from the [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/lufia/#chara]official website[/url]]
